assertions.assertion: The claim was denied under reason code PR-204.
CPT 93247 represents long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope.
Syncope and presyncope correspond to diagnosis code R55.
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency corresponds to diagnosis code I34.0.
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
Unspecified cardiac arrhythmia corresponds to diagnosis code I49.9.
There is a clinical indication note documenting the indication.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature.
There is a need to correlate clinical events with underlying rhythm disturbances.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of collapse.
The denial determination stated the service is not covered under the member's benefit plan.
An appeal/reconsideration of the determination is being requested.
